replyText: Hi Jagjivansingh, thanks for the honest feedback. Accuracy is our top priority. If errors involve names or specific terms, try adding them to your Personal Dictionary so Voiskey learns them. We’d also love to know what kinds of mistakes you see (accent, language, background noise) so we can improve.
